title: Remove OptiSweep Gripper at the Operator Station (LOTO + Disconnect Valve/Air/Cables)
summary: Safely stop the OptiSweep tipper cycle from the operator station HMI, lock out the tipper at the station e-panel, and disconnect the gripper hardware (valve cover, supply air line, four M8 connectors, and the A-axis cable carrier routed through the grommet) to prepare for gripper replacement.
when_to_use: Use when performing OptiSweep gripper replacement removal at the operator station and you must stop the cycle, LOTO the tipper, and disconnect the gripper’s valve/air/electrical connections and A-axis cable carrier.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Executes HMI cycle stop/jog positioning, performs station e-panel LOTO, and performs the physical disconnection/removal steps for the gripper hardware.
safety_notes: CAUTION HEAVY EQUIPMENT: Components may be heavy. Use caution when lifting. Failure to follow these instructions can result in injury or equipment damage.
access_or_tools_needed: Axis buttons for the corresponding tipper
Tools: 2.5-mm hex wrench, 3-mm hex wrench, 5-mm hex wrench, 6-mm hex wrench, Loctite® (as listed)
Replacement part: gripper (for the overall replacement task)

system_preconditions: Operator station HMI is available to navigate to the "Visu_MCP_Dual" screen.
external_references: Operator Station Lockout/Tagout (referenced by the manual on page 2; content not included in this packet)

steps.title: Navigate to Visu_MCP_Dual on the operator station HMI
steps.purpose: Open the operator station screen that provides cycle stop and manual jog controls for positioning the gripper.
steps.instruction: At the operator station HMI, navigate to the "Visu_MCP_Dual" screen.
steps.expected_result: The "Visu_MCP_Dual" screen is displayed and ready for control inputs.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the controls needed to stop the cycle and manually jog the tipper (CYCLE STOP and JOG).
steps.failure_condition: You cannot access the "Visu_MCP_Dual" screen or cannot locate the CYCLE STOP/JOG controls.

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: At the operator station HMI, navigate to the "Visu_MCP_Dual" screen.

steps.title: Stop the cycle and enable manual tipper control
steps.purpose: Bring the system to a stopped state and switch to manual control for positioning the gripper.
steps.instruction: Press CYCLE STOP to stop the cycle, then press JOG to manually control the tipper.
steps.expected_result: The cycle is stopped and manual control is enabled via JOG.
steps.healthy_condition: The tipper is under manual control (JOG active) and the cycle is not running.
steps.failure_condition: The cycle does not stop or manual control cannot be enabled.

actions.label: Cycle stop
actions.exact_action: Press CYCLE STOP to stop the cycle

actions.label: Enable jog
actions.exact_action: press JOG to manually control the tipper

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: Press CYCLE STOP to stop the cycle, then press JOG to manually control the tipper.

steps.title: Move the gripper to the desired location using axis buttons
steps.purpose: Position the gripper so it can be safely disconnected and removed.
steps.instruction: Use the axis buttons for the corresponding tipper to move the gripper to the desired location.
steps.expected_result: The gripper is positioned at the desired location using the axis buttons.
steps.healthy_condition: The gripper moves as commanded and reaches the intended position for the removal/disconnection steps.
steps.failure_condition: The gripper does not move as expected or cannot be positioned to the required location.

actions.label: Move gripper
actions.exact_action: Use the axis buttons for the corresponding tipper to move the gripper to the desired location

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: Use the axis buttons for the corresponding tipper to move the gripper to the desired location.

steps.title: Support carriages if gripper is moved from home position
steps.purpose: Prevent carriage drop by supporting them with screws when the gripper is not at its home position.
steps.instruction: If the gripper is moved from its home position, thread screws into the threaded holes in the column to support the carriages between the pair or holes.
steps.expected_result: Screws are threaded into the column threaded holes to support the carriages between the pair or holes.
steps.healthy_condition: Carriages are supported by the threaded screws (no unsupported drop condition).
steps.failure_condition: You cannot support the carriages with screws in the threaded holes, or support is incomplete.

actions.label: Thread support screws
actions.exact_action: thread screws into the threaded holes in the column to support the carriages between the pair or holes

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if you cannot support the carriages while preparing for gripper removal.

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: NOTE: If the gripper is moved from its home position, thread screws into the threaded holes in the column to support the carriages between the pair or holes.

steps.title: LOTO the tipper at the station e-panel
steps.purpose: Ensure the tipper is locked out before disconnecting and removing gripper hardware.
steps.instruction: LOTO the tipper at the station e-panel (see "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).
steps.expected_result: The tipper is locked out at the station e-panel.
steps.healthy_condition: LOTO is applied at the station e-panel for the tipper you are working on.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot perform LOTO safely or cannot confirm LOTO is applied at the station e-panel.

actions.label: Apply LOTO
actions.exact_action: LOTO the tipper at the station e-panel

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if you cannot perform LOTO safely at the station e-panel.

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: LOTO the tipper at the station e-panel (see "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).

steps.title: Verify correct gripper selection (left vs right)
steps.purpose: Ensure you disconnect the correct gripper hardware before removing valve cover, air line, and connectors.
steps.instruction: Verify the correct gripper has been selected (i.e., left gripper or right gripper).
steps.expected_result: You confirm whether the left or right gripper is selected for the removal/disconnection work.
steps.healthy_condition: The selected gripper matches the physical gripper you are about to disconnect.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot confirm left vs right gripper selection before disconnecting hardware.

actions.label: Confirm left/right selection
actions.exact_action: Verify the correct gripper has been selected (i.e., left gripper or right gripper)

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if you cannot confirm the correct gripper selection (left vs right) before disconnecting hardware.

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: Verify the correct gripper has been selected (i.e., left gripper or right gripper).

steps.title: Remove valve cover (four M4x50 socket-head screws)
steps.purpose: Expose the valve/gripper assembly connections for subsequent disconnection steps.
steps.instruction: Remove the four (4) M4x50 socket-head screws from the valve cover, then remove the valve cover.
steps.expected_result: The valve cover is removed after removing the four M4x50 socket-head screws.
steps.healthy_condition: Valve cover is fully detached and removed; screws are removed from the cover.
steps.failure_condition: Valve cover cannot be removed or screws are not fully removed.

actions.label: Remove valve cover screws
actions.exact_action: Remove the four (4) M4x50 socket-head screws from the valve cover

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: Remove the four (4) M4x50 socket-head screws from the valve cover. Remove the valve cover.

steps.title: Disconnect all four M8 connectors
steps.purpose: Disconnect electrical connections to the gripper/valve assembly before removing or further disconnecting air and cable components.
steps.expected_result: All four M8 connectors are disconnected from the valve/gripper assembly.
steps.healthy_condition: No M8 connectors remain connected to the gripper/valve assembly.
steps.failure_condition: Any M8 connector remains connected or cannot be disconnected.

steps.title: Disconnect the supply air line on top of the valve
steps.purpose: Remove pneumatic connection so the gripper can be disconnected and removed safely.
steps.instruction: Disconnect the supply air line on the top of the valve.
steps.expected_result: The supply air line is disconnected from the top of the valve.
steps.healthy_condition: Air line is disconnected at the valve connection point.
steps.failure_condition: Air line cannot be disconnected or remains attached.

actions.label: Disconnect air line
actions.exact_action: Disconnect the supply air line on the top of the valve

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: Disconnect the supply air line on the top of the valve.

steps.title: Plug fitting and cap air line to prevent debris entry
steps.purpose: Prevent debris from entering the air line/fitting after disconnection.
steps.instruction: Plug the fitting and cap the air line to prevent debris from entering either; if plugs/caps are not available, use tape to protect both.
steps.expected_result: The fitting is plugged and the air line is capped (or protected with tape if plugs/caps are unavailable).
steps.healthy_condition: Both ends are protected against debris entry.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot apply plugs/caps or tape protection to both the fitting and air line.

actions.label: Protect air line ends
actions.exact_action: Plug the fitting and cap the air line... If plugs and caps are not available, use tape to protect both.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if plugs/caps (or tape protection) cannot be applied to prevent debris entering the air line/fitting.

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: Plug the fitting and cap the air line to prevent debris from entering either. If plugs and caps are not available, use tape to protect both.

steps.title: Feed capped air line through the grommet
steps.purpose: Route the protected air line through the grommet to clear the assembly for cable routing/disconnection.
steps.instruction: Feed the capped air line through the grommet.
steps.expected_result: The capped air line is routed through the grommet.
steps.healthy_condition: Air line passes through the grommet without obstruction and remains capped/plugged.
steps.failure_condition: Air line cannot be fed through the grommet or becomes unprotected.

actions.label: Route air line
actions.exact_action: Feed the capped air line through the grommet

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: Feed the capped air line through the grommet.

steps.title: Pull jacketed cable out of the grommet
steps.purpose: Clear the cable routing so the M8 connectors and A-axis cable carrier can be detached.
steps.instruction: Pull the jacketed part of the cable out of the grommet.
steps.expected_result: The jacketed part of the cable is pulled out of the grommet.
steps.healthy_condition: Cable jacket is free from the grommet and can be routed/handled for the next steps.
steps.failure_condition: Cable cannot be pulled out or is snagged such that it cannot be safely routed.

actions.label: Pull cable
actions.exact_action: Pull the jacketed part of the cable out of the grommet

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: Pull the jacketed part of the cable out of the grommet.

steps.title: Feed all M8 connectors through the grommet one at a time
steps.purpose: Route the disconnected electrical connectors through the grommet to free the gripper assembly.
steps.instruction: Feed all of the M8 connectors through the grommet one at a time.
steps.expected_result: All four M8 connectors are routed through the grommet.
steps.healthy_condition: Each M8 connector passes through the grommet without damage and is fully free of the grommet.
steps.failure_condition: Any M8 connector cannot be fed through the grommet or is damaged during routing.

actions.label: Route M8 connectors
actions.exact_action: Feed all of the M8 connectors through the grommet one at a time

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: Feed all of the M8 connectors through the grommet one at a time.

steps.title: Detach A-axis cable carrier by removing two M3x8 screws (save screws)
steps.purpose: Free the A-axis cable carrier from the gripper so the gripper can be removed.
steps.instruction: Detach the A-axis cable carrier from the gripper by removing the two (2) M3x8 screws holding the cable carrier end. Save the screws.
steps.expected_result: A-axis cable carrier is detached from the gripper; the two M3x8 screws are removed and saved.
steps.healthy_condition: Cable carrier end is free and screws are retained for later use.
steps.failure_condition: Cable carrier cannot be detached or screws are lost/not saved.

actions.label: Remove cable carrier screws
actions.exact_action: remove the two (2) M3x8 screws holding the cable carrier end. Save the screws

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: Detach the A-axis cable carrier from the gripper by removing the two (2) M3x8 screws holding the cable carrier end. NOTE: Save the screws.

steps.title: Reinstall valve cover using four M4x50 socket-head screws
steps.purpose: Restore the valve cover after disconnecting air/electrical and before proceeding to gripper-to-gearbox fastener removal.
steps.instruction: Install the valve cover using the four (4) M4x50 socket-head screws.
steps.expected_result: Valve cover is reinstalled and secured with four M4x50 socket-head screws.
steps.healthy_condition: Valve cover is seated and all four screws are installed.
steps.failure_condition: Valve cover is not fully seated or screws cannot be installed.

actions.label: Reinstall valve cover
actions.exact_action: Install the valve cover using the four (4) M4x50 socket-head screws

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: Install the valve cover using the four (4) M4x50 socket-head screws.

steps.title: Remove gripper-to-gearbox attachment screws (M6x20) and support counter-balance
steps.purpose: Detach the gripper from the gearbox while preventing imbalance by supporting the counter-balance.
steps.instruction: Remove the 10 M6x20 socket-head screws attaching the gripper to the gearbox (suggested: fully remove nine (9) screws). Ensure the counter-balance is supported.
steps.expected_result: The gripper-to-gearbox attachment screws are removed (with the suggested approach of fully removing nine), and the counter-balance is supported.
steps.healthy_condition: Counter-balance remains supported during screw removal; gripper attachment is loosened as intended.
steps.failure_condition: Counter-balance cannot be supported while removing the gripper-to-gearbox screws.

actions.label: Remove M6x20 screws
actions.exact_action: Remove the 10 M6x20 socket-head screws attaching the gripper to the gearbox (suggested: fully remove nine (9) screws). Ensure the counter-balance is supported.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the counter-balance cannot be supported while removing the gripper-to-gearbox screws.

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: Remove the 10 M6x20 socket-head screws attaching the gripper to the gearbox. a. It is suggested to fully remove nine (9) of the screws. b. Ensure the counter-balance is supported.

success_criteria: Cycle is stopped and tipper is LOTO’d.
Valve cover is removed (then reinstalled per procedure).
Supply air line is disconnected and protected (plugged/capped or taped).
Air line and cable are routed through the grommet.
A-axis cable carrier is detached by removing two M3x8 screws (saved).
Gripper-to-gearbox attachment screws (M6x20) are removed with counter-balance supported.
healthy_conditions: LOTO is applied at the station e-panel for the tipper being serviced.
Correct left vs right gripper selection is confirmed before disconnecting hardware.
Air line fitting and air line are protected to prevent debris entry.
Counter-balance is supported during M6x20 screw removal.
failure_conditions: Cannot confirm correct gripper selection (left vs right) before disconnecting hardware.
Counter-balance cannot be supported while removing gripper-to-gearbox screws.
Cannot apply plugs/caps (or tape protection) to prevent debris entering the air line/fitting.
Valve cover cannot be removed/reinstalled as specified (screws not removed/installed).
Any M8 connector cannot be disconnected or routed through the grommet.
escalation_guidance: If you cannot confirm correct gripper selection (left vs right) before disconnecting hardware, stop work and escalate.
If you cannot support the counter-balance while removing the gripper-to-gearbox screws, stop work and escalate.
If plugs/caps (or tape protection) cannot be applied to prevent debris entering the air line/fitting, stop work and escalate.
If you cannot perform LOTO safely at the station e-panel, stop work and escalate.
missing_details: The manual references "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2, but the LOTO procedure content and the exact e-panel lockout/tagout label/location are not included in this packet; operators must follow the referenced LOTO procedure.
